description: Edit an existing video clip (MP4, up to 15 seconds, 50 MB) following instructions: put the person from a photo into the clip, change outfit, style, background or scene, while keeping the motion and timing. Costs credits (based on clip length). Returns a task_id; poll get_video.

image_urls.description: Optional reference photos, referred to as image 1, image 2… in the prompt.

prompt.description: What to change, e.g. "Replace the dancer with the person in image 1, keep the moves".

video_url.description: Public https URL of the MP4 clip to edit.

name: edit_video
title: Edit a video
